task_description: Create a fully agentic NiceGUI-based Python chat application using Strands Agents SDK with Amazon Bedrock Sonnet 4.5 (US profile) for LLM with reasoning/thinking enabled, streaming responses, large document upload to S3 (ntkey- bucket prefix) with multipart upload, document analysis via Amazon Bedrock Data Automation, web search capability, and AWS CDK infrastructure. Uses existing GxPEC2-role. Runs locally with AWS session credentials.

verification.summary: All 18 Python files pass AST parsing. ruff check passes with no errors on app/, tests/, cdk/. pyproject.toml is valid TOML. cdk.json is valid JSON. Tests cover: agent config (model ID, streaming, thinking, tools, system prompt, callback handler), upload tool (small file, multipart, abort on error), analyze tool (success, timeout, service error), web search (callable, returns string), CDK stack (S3 bucket name, no new IAM roles, outputs, lifecycle rules, CORS). Docker build skipped due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network.
